_doc: Curated milestones in Ethiopia's IMF programme and debt restructuring (G20 Common Framework). Hand-maintained; keep each entry dated and sourced. Reviewed with the monthly checklist.
programme: IMF Extended Credit Facility (ECF) and G20 Common Framework debt treatment

events.label: Ethiopia requests G20 Common Framework treatment
events.detail: Ethiopia became one of the first countries to seek debt treatment under the G20 Common Framework.

events.label: IMF Board approves four-year ECF (~US$3.4bn)
events.detail: Approval unlocked immediate financing and underpinned the shift to a market-based exchange rate.

events.label: Official-creditor (Paris Club / China) agreement in principle
events.detail: Ethiopia reached understandings with its Official Creditor Committee on restructuring terms.

note: Programme reviews occur roughly twice a year; dates shift. Check the IMF Ethiopia country page for the latest review and disbursement.
